summary: Pre-Launch Comprehensive Testing - ZOZO Burger Application. Tested backend APIs (75% success), homepage, navigation, and identified critical UI interaction issues with modal overlays.

minor_bugs.issue: 8 admin endpoints failing with 401 'Invalid token' - appears to be test script issue with token management, not backend issue
minor_bugs.note: These endpoints work when tested individually with correct token. Issue is with test script token restoration after manager login test.

fixed_bugs.issue: Group order add-items endpoint required 'expires_at' field in request body
fixed_bugs.fix: Removed unnecessary 'expires_at' field from GroupOrderAddItems model

critical_bugs.issue: Cookie banner and order type dialog overlays intercept clicks, preventing location selection
critical_bugs.symptoms: When clicking 'Jetzt bestellen', order type dialog opens but location selection is blocked by overlays. Playwright reports: 'element intercepts pointer events'
critical_bugs.recommendation: Add force=True to Playwright clicks OR fix z-index/overlay stacking in frontend code. Cookie banner should auto-dismiss or have lower z-index.

ui_bugs.issue: Featured products carousel not found on homepage
ui_bugs.note: May be hidden or not rendering. Check if featured products are configured in database.
